# tests/fixtures/

Committed test data. **Synthetic only.**

FIA WEC timing data may not be redistributed, so no extract of a real timing
file ever goes here -- putting one under `tests/` to get around the `data/`
rules is exactly the thing these rules exist to prevent. See
`docs/DECISIONS.md` D-003.

Requirements for a fixture:

- Generated by this project, resembling the verified schema but containing no
  real timing data.
- A header comment marking it synthetic.
- Small enough to verify by eye -- if you cannot work out the expected output
  by hand, the fixture is too big to be useful as a test.
- If a fixture grows too large to commit, commit its generator script instead.

Empty until the TASK 1 audit establishes the real schema. A fixture written
against an assumed schema would encode the assumption it is supposed to test.
